svg.title: TRELLICK TOWER — DETACHED SERVICE CORE & SCISSOR SECTION
svg.desc: Orthographic elevation and cross-section of Trellick Tower by Ernő Goldfinger showing 98.0 m slab, 120.0 m service shaft, cantilevered boiler house, and 3-storey scissor maisonettes.
